name: laplace
description: Linux in the browser on the v86 emulator with deterministic recording and replay of sessions
author: Bogdan

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.test:browser:prepare: mkdir -p app/test/out && node app/test/engine.node.mjs record buildroot app/test/out/br1.json images/buildroot-boot.snap
